newsitem.title: USA: Ralston Purina Co Q4 Sept 30 oper net up.
newsitem.headline: Ralston Purina Co Q4 Sept 30 oper net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 operating earnings exclude $15.5 million or $0.15/share primary ($0.14 diluted) restructuring charge.

Q4 1995 operating results pro forma and exclude $37.7 million or $0.37 a share primary ($0.34 diluted) charge for restructuring battery operations, $1.8 million or $0.02 primary and diluted pro forma charge for adjustment due to Continental Baking sale, $42.0 million or $0.41 a share primary ($0.38 diluted) gain on sale of Continental Baking, and $3.7 million or $0.04 primary ($0.03 diluted) extraordinary charge.
Including items in both periods, Q4 1996 net earnings $89.8 million or $0.85 a share primary ($0.80 diluted) vs $75.7 million or $0.70 primary ($0.67 diluted).
Q4 1995 net sales exclude results of operations for Continental Baking, which was sold. Including Continental Baking, net sales were $1.60 billion.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
Fiscal 1996 operating income excludes $15.5 million or $0.15 a share primary ($0.14 diluted) restructuring charge and $2.1 million or $0.02 a share primary and diluted extraordinary charge.

Fiscal 1995 operating income excludes $70.0 million or $0.68 a share primary ($0.63 diluted) restructuring charge, $4.8 million or $0.07 primary ($0.04 diluted) charge to adjust for Continental Baking sale, $42.0 million or $0.41 primary ($0.38 diluted) gain for Continental Baking sale and $3.7 million or $0.04 primary ($0.03 diluted) extraordinary charge.
Including all items, fiscal 1996 net earnings $359.6 million or $3.39 primary ($3.21 diluted) vs fiscal 1995 eanrings of $296.4 million or $2.72 primary ($2.63 diluted).
Fiscal 1995 net sales excluding Continental Baking. Including Continental baking, fiscal 1995 sales $7.17 billion.
